nodes.label: Image.open()
nodes.desc: Reads a 16-byte prefix, tries extension-specific plugin, then preinit() and init() fallbacks before raising UnidentifiedImageError.

nodes.label: Image.frombytes()
nodes.desc: Creates a blank image and pushes raw bytes through a named decoder.

nodes.label: Image.new()
nodes.desc: Allocates a zeroed Imaging buffer via Image.core.new(mode, size).

nodes.label: _decompression_bomb_check
nodes.desc: MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = 1 GiB // 4 // 3: roughly a quarter gigabyte for 24-bit pixels; trips DecompressionBombWarning or Error.

nodes.label: ID / OPEN / SAVE / EXTENSION
nodes.desc: Module-level lists and dicts (ID, OPEN, MIME, SAVE, SAVE_ALL, EXTENSION, DECODERS, ENCODERS) shared by every plugin.

nodes.label: Image.register_open()
nodes.desc: Appends id to ID and stores (factory, accept) in OPEN[id.upper()].

nodes.label: Image.register_decoder()
nodes.desc: Populates DECODERS so _getdecoder prefers Python codecs before C ones.

nodes.label: Image._getdecoder()
nodes.desc: Codec factory: checks DECODERS dict, then resolves {name}_decoder on the _imaging C module.

nodes.label: _plugins list
nodes.desc: 47 plugin module names; init() __import__s each and swallows ImportError.

nodes.label: BmpImagePlugin
nodes.desc: _accept checks b'BM'; _bitmap reads header_size 12, 40, 52, 56, 64, 108 or 124 and picks raw or bmp_rle decoding.

nodes.label: PngImagePlugin
nodes.desc: Parses chunk stream, buffers IDAT data, and registers a zip tile for the entropy-coded rows.

nodes.label: JpegImagePlugin
nodes.desc: Marker scanner: SOI, SOF0/2, DHT, DQT; raw JPEG data handed to the libjpeg decoder.

nodes.label: BmpRleDecoder
nodes.desc: PyDecoder subclass implementing RLE4/RLE8 run expansion in Python.

nodes.label: ImageFile.ImageFile
nodes.desc: Abstract lazy base: _open fills tile; load() materializes pixels; draft(), load_prepare(), load_end() hooks.

nodes.label: _Tile NamedTuple
nodes.desc: (decoder_name, extents, offset, args) quadruple; one entry per span of encoded data.

nodes.label: ImageFile.load()
nodes.desc: Per tile: seek(offset), build decoder, then while-loop read(decodermaxblock) and decoder.decode(b) until n < 0.

nodes.label: tile.sort(key=_tilesort)
nodes.desc: Sorts tiles by file offset and drops consecutive duplicates that differ only by offset.

nodes.label: mmap fast path
nodes.desc: Single-tile raw files map the whole file with mmap and call Image.core.map_buffer, no copies.

nodes.label: LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES
nodes.desc: Module flag: when False, truncated reads raise 'image file is truncated'; when True, the loop breaks and keeps partial pixels.

nodes.label: ERRORS err-code map
nodes.desc: C decoders return negative codes; _get_oserror translates them into OSError messages at the end of load().

nodes.label: PyDecoder
nodes.desc: Python codec base: setimage(), decode(b) returning (bytes_consumed, err_code), optional pulls_fd.

nodes.label: PyEncoder
nodes.desc: Python encoder base used by ImageFile._save for formats implemented without C codecs.

nodes.label: JpegDecode.c
nodes.desc: libjpeg glue: DecodingState fill and scanline shuffling into Imaging buffers.

nodes.label: ZipDecode.c
nodes.desc: zlib inflate state machine backing PNG and zip-tile decoding.

nodes.label: TiffDecode.c
nodes.desc: libtiff glue handling strips, tiles and photometric conversions.

nodes.label: Unpack.c
nodes.desc: Raw decoder: a giant table mapping (mode, rawmode, bits) to per-pixel unpacking kernels.

nodes.label: ImagingNew
nodes.desc: ImagingNew / ImagingNewDirty / ImagingNewBlock choose block or arena allocation for pixel storage.

nodes.label: ImagingNewInternal
nodes.desc: Allocates via ImagingAllocateArray with arena block_size, then retries once with 4096-byte pages before failing.

nodes.label: Imaging handle
nodes.desc: typedef struct ImagingMemoryInstance *Imaging; header documents per-mode byte layouts (1, L, P, I, F, RGB...).

nodes.label: precompute_coeffs
nodes.desc: Separable resize: coefficient precomputation plus 8bpc/16bpc/32bpc horizontal and vertical kernels.

nodes.label: ImagingGaussianBlur
nodes.desc: Gaussian blur approximated by three box-blur passes computed over expandable buffers.
